agent_position: Group keys under named issuers and refuse a duplicate kid, overlapping ranges, and invalid ranges at load
owner_disposition: Grouped issuers as recommended, plus: key ids unique by construction rather than only refused on collision (settled as D3a, the JWK thumbprint); narrowing a range, or any change refusing a grant once admitted, waits for the affected grants to end, since frps rechecks only at re-registration; a signer's window lies within its range, a wider one failing visibly as a refused registration; checking ranges against frps allowPorts is out of scope
summary: Owner added unique-by-construction key ids, a drain rule before narrowing, and window-within-range to the issuer model

agent_position: Test frp 0.61.1 fetched from pinned, checksum-verified archives; default suite skips without binaries and a gate target fails on skip; keep D5's cases and add non-tcp, client-wide-only, fail-closed with recovery, and the drain premise
owner_disposition: As recommended, plus: SHA-256 pinned per archive in the tool, never verified against the release's own checksums file; linux_amd64 only, other platforms via FRPS_BIN/FRPC_BIN; no sleeps, proxy state read through frpc's admin /api/status with bounded waits, the admit case also carrying traffic; every port chosen at runtime on loopback; the gate job in tests.yml so validation can owe it; fail-closed also for a 500 or malformed plugin answer, the recovery wait sized to frpc's retry interval and commented; the drain premise forced by restarting frpc; a fifth case showing an frpc reload re-registers only the new proxy. Noted for prove-relay-provisioning: its roles verify pinned checksums and may check their frp version against the tool's pins
summary: Owner tightened the real-frp tests: per-archive pins, no sleeps, runtime ports, tests.yml gate, broader fail-closed, and a reload case
